statements.status_notes: The Rancher Agent 2.12 release retains the legacy golang-jwt/jwt 3.2.1+incompatible module alongside separately versioned JWT modules. ParseUnverified splits attacker-controlled token text on every period, producing excessive memory allocation for a long malformed token. The advisory lists no patched legacy-module release; fixes are available in jwt/v4 4.5.2 and jwt/v5 5.2.2. Rancher 2.12 still directly requires the legacy module, and updating the separate v4 or v5 modules cannot repair it. Migration of its callers, a compatible backport, and actual exposure of untrusted token parsing in the agent remain under investigation; token-size controls are not asserted as an established mitigation. Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-mh63-6h87-95cp
